svg.desc: Two-topic cohort · first/latest publication affiliations, 2016–2025 · retrieved 2026-11-06 Source: OpenAlex core · https://api.openalex.org Retrieved: works 2026-11-06; author histories 2026-11-06. Observed through 2025-12-31. Method: atlas-primary-publications-v1. Two-topic cohort (P2): brain-computer interfaces and electroencephalography (EEG), and neural engineering (T10429 and T11601). First and latest observed paper affiliations for researchers first seen in brain–computer interfaces/EEG or neural engineering in 2016–2025, with at least two active publication years. Ribbon widths show people; same-sector endpoints are included. One shared people-count scale across all four origin and destination sectors. Same-sector ribbons mean equal sectors at the first/latest observed paper; intervening changes are not measured. Affiliations reflect paper metadata; employment history is unmeasured. No listed affiliation means missing paper-affiliation metadata. From Universities (20,706 people): Universities 18,781 (90.7%) — same sector at first/latest paper; No listed affiliation 1,091 (5.3%); Other institutions 740 (3.6%); Companies 94 (0.5%). From Companies (296 people): Universities 43 (14.5%); No listed affiliation 49 (16.6%); Other institutions 8 (2.7%); Companies 196 (66.2%) — same sector at first/latest paper. From Other institutions (2,469 people): Universities 688 (27.9%); No listed affiliation 156 (6.3%); Other institutions 1,609 (65.2%) — same sector at first/latest paper; Companies 16 (0.6%). From No listed affiliation (3,022 people): Universities 1,624 (53.7%); No listed affiliation 1,132 (37.5%) — metadata missing at both endpoints; Other institutions 243 (8%); Companies 23 (0.8%).
